laws.rule: Great Walk huts must be booked in advance on DOC's booking system; international visitors pay higher summer rates (October to April) and DOC staff run random checks at huts. Routeburn Track: international adult NZD 132 a hut night in summer (about A$106, RBA rate of 30 October 2026); campsites NZD 42.

layers.process: Routeburn Track through Mount Aspiring and Fiordland national parks: DOC lists the Great Walks season as 1 November 2026 to 30 April 2027 and requires huts and campsites to be booked in that season. Outside that season bookings are not required and weather, alpine and river-crossing hazards increase; check DOC notices and be appropriately skilled.
